speakingPractice.title: One-minute Speaking Practice
speakingPractice.description: Record immediately or after a 3- or 5-second countdown, then practise with basic checks and take comparisons.
speakingPractice.privacy: Start recording and basic checks without a large AI model. Speech recognition and optional coaching run on your device; recordings and transcripts are not uploaded to an AI server.

intro.label: Self-introduction
intro.question: Introduce yourself in Korean in one minute.
intro.hint: Your work or interests → a relevant experience → your strength
intro.sample: 저는 사람들의 불편을 줄이는 도구를 만드는 개발자입니다. 최근에는 유류비 계산기의 입력 과정을 단순하게 바꿨습니다. 사용자의 입장에서 문제를 찾고 개선하는 것이 제 강점입니다.
intro.sampleBefore: 저는 개발자고요. 최근에 유류비 계산기 입력 과정을 바꿨어요. 사람들이 불편한 걸 줄이는 도구를 만들고, 사용자 입장에서 문제를 찾고 개선하는 게 강점이에요.

report.label: Work update
report.question: Explain your progress and current status in Korean.
report.hint: Completed work → verified results → current status or next step
report.sample: 유류비 계산기 개편을 마쳤습니다. 함께 정산과 차량 저장 기능을 추가했습니다. 기능 테스트까지 완료했으며, 현재 배포 전입니다.

guideSteps: Choose a question and immediate start or a 3- or 5-second countdown. Recording starts after permission and preparation. Recording and playback require no model download.
Whisper tiny downloads only when you transcribe audio. Correct names, numbers and missing words.
Review automatic basic checks for duration, possible fillers, repeated words and structure cues.
Record again, compare with your first take, and save on this device. Choose generative coaching only when you want a rewritten answer.

faq.q: Do I have to download 1.1GB to start?
faq.a: No. Recording, typing, basic checks, comparison and saving work without a generative model. Transcription uses about 41MB of Whisper tiny weights plus runtime files. The roughly 1.1GB coaching download starts only after you opt in and run it.

faq.q: Can I use this on a phone?
faq.a: Basic checks work without WebGPU. On-device transcription may take time on some phones. Cancelling processing preserves your recording and text. Generative coaching requires WebGPU and sufficient memory.

Recording duration, whitespace-separated word count and pace, possible filler words, words repeated at least three times, and mode-specific structure cues. These are text rules, not semantic assessment or pronunciation scores. Fillers omitted by transcription cannot be counted.

faq.q: Are recordings sent to a server?
faq.a: Speech recognition and optional coaching run in your browser. Model files are downloaded, but audio and transcripts are not uploaded to an AI server. Saved records remain in this browser.

faq.q: Can I remove the coaching download?
faq.a: Use Remove downloaded coaching model in coaching settings. It clears this site’s coaching model cache while preserving practice records and the speech model. Running coaching again may download it again.

faq.q: Can I have a countdown before recording?
faq.a: Choose immediate start or a 3- or 5-second preparation period. It begins after microphone permission is granted and does not count toward the recording duration or 90-second limit. Cancelling or leaving during preparation does not start recording automatically; start again explicitly.

basic.title: Basic checks
basic.noDownload: Basic checks need no generative model download.
basic.preview: Review duration, pace, possible fillers, repeated words and structure cues before trying again.

duration.unknown: Typed answers have no assumed duration. Record a take to compare with the 60-second target.
duration.short: This answer is shorter than 60 seconds. Expand on one experience or result already in your answer.
duration.onTarget: Close to one minute. The 45–75 second range is a practice guide, not a scoring standard.
duration.long: This answer is longer than 60 seconds. Trim repeated ideas and start with the main point.

basic.noFillers: No candidate words found in this transcript.
basic.noRepeats: No words meet the display criteria.
basic.limits: These are word and phrase rules. Fillers may be omitted by transcription or used as ordinary words. A missing cue does not prove missing content. Repeated words exclude some common words and show up to five types.

next.intro: Try role → one experience from your answer → your strength.
next.report: Try completed work → current status → next step. Keep completed and planned work distinct.
